purpose: Diagnostic test of the frozen Mae Sai adaptive-Otsu radar decision rule on a separate mapped flood event.

dataset.selection: All 29 tiles of sample AOI EMSR712-3; no tile selection by labels or scores.

reference_semantics.0: mapped background, not independently confirmed dry

dataset.source_overlap: CEMS AOI03 MONIT04 uses the 2024-01-03 05:34 Sentinel-1 acquisition also supplied as the sample post-event S1GRD. Agreement with this CEMS-derived map is not independent accuracy. CEMS monitoring extent may accumulate earlier mapped flood; the packaged label's exact vector lineage must be checked and any unresolved ambiguity reported.

prediction.valid_radiometry: All four VV/VH source values must be finite and strictly positive linear sigma0; otherwise abstain.
prediction.threshold_surface: Arithmetic mean of qualified overlapping-window thresholds on each tile.
prediction.positive_rule: change_db >= threshold_db AND change_db > 0 AND VV_drop_db > 0 AND VH_drop_db > 0
prediction.abstain_rule: Invalid source radiometry or no qualified overlapping window.
prediction.adaptation_limits: This is a separate S1GRD Sigma0 research adapter. It does not run the Mae Sai Gamma0 SNAP preprocessing contract; it omits the M2 permanent-water and terrain-slope input masks rather than deriving them from benchmark labels.

evaluation.primary_comparison: label 2 versus labels 0 and 1 in mapped validity=1 cells; label 255 and validity=0 excluded
evaluation.secondary_comparison: label 2 versus label 0, with permanent-water label 1 excluded and its count disclosed
evaluation.aggregation: Sum confusion counts across all 29 tiles before computing aggregate ratios; report per-tile counts and scores too.
evaluation.zero_denominator: Report null; never replace an undefined score with zero.
evaluation.reason_no_limits: One source-correlated sample activation is a diagnostic, not a confirmatory holdout or independent accuracy study.

safety.score_description: Agreement with CEMS-derived benchmark labels, not independent flood accuracy or Mae Sai validation.
